senses.sense_definition: The largest city in Michigan, United States, located on the Detroit River and historically known as a major automotive manufacturing center.

examples.text: Many people visit <w>Detroit</w> to learn about the history of the American car industry.
The <w>Motor</w> <w>City</w> is another name often used to refer to <w>Detroit</w>.

senses.sense_definition: A metonym for the United States automotive industry.

examples.text: Economic changes have significantly impacted <w>Detroit</w> and its ability to compete globally.
The decline of <w>Detroit</w> forced many workers to seek employment in other sectors.
